event_chain.summary: Servers encrypted, external systems shut down

summary: In June 2026 Latvia's state-owned forestry company Latvijas valsts meži (LVM) was hit by a ransomware attack that compromised its servers and forced it to shut down external systems, disrupting timber deliveries and its LVM GEO app for weeks. Cert.lv attributed it to a foreign, financially motivated ransomware group that also accessed a server of pharmaceutical maker Olpha (a technically separate incident). LVM said no ransom for decryption had been demanded.
